meta.titleEn: Trimebutine Maleate 100 mg Tablets (Gastrointestinal Motility Regulator)
meta.actionKo: 위장관 운동을 조절하여 소화기능이상과 과민성대장증후군 증상을 완화합니다.
meta.actionEn: Regulates gastrointestinal motility to relieve digestive dysfunction and symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome.

933f25a8.symKo: 식도역류·열공헤르니아·위십이지장염·위십이지장궤양의 소화기능이상(복통·소화불량·구역·구토), 과민성대장증후군·경련성 결장, 소아 습관성 구토·비감염성 장관통과장애(변비·설사)
933f25a8.symEn: Digestive dysfunction (abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting) in esophageal reflux, hiatal hernia, gastroduodenitis, gastric/duodenal ulcers; irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon; pediatric habitual vomiting and non-infectious intestinal transit disorders (constipation, diarrhea)
933f25a8.pointKo: 위장관 운동을 조절해 복통·소화불량·구역·구토와 과민성대장증후군 증상을 완화합니다.
933f25a8.pointEn: Regulates gastrointestinal motility to relieve abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, and irritable bowel symptoms.
